title: Implement the PostgreSQL crawl frontier with leasing
summary: Implemented a tenant-exact PostgreSQL crawl frontier with versioned URL identities, concurrent batch discovery, fair organization/host/scan leasing through FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, digest-only lease ownership, heartbeat, idempotent completion and retry, stale recovery, incremental Scan progress, bounded recurring maintenance, database protections and representative query-plan evidence. Also repaired the stale Prompt 063 dashboard request assertion and rebuilt the test database from a clean synchronized structure dump.

migrations: 20260904149000_create_crawl_frontier.rb: creates an empty bigint frontier table with exact scan and same-scan-parent foreign keys; lifecycle checks; partial leasing/recovery indexes; immutable identity/deletion trigger; no existing-row rewrite
decisions: PostgreSQL is the frontier source of truth and Solid Queue only wakes workers
Only SHA-256 lease token digests persist while raw 256-bit tokens are returned once
Scan counters are transactionally maintained so progress reads never aggregate crawl_urls
Hash partition by scan is the documented future partitioning direction
risks: The fair ranking query materializes eligible work; the 10500-row PostgreSQL plan uses the partial index but production scale must be observed
fetch_result_id intentionally has no foreign key until the crawl fetch relation is introduced
bin/quality itself stops at JavaScript because the web image lacks Node.js; every component was run separately with JavaScript validated on the host and data validation under worker_default
